## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A roadmap item depending on a contract becomes a ready queue entry when its...

The system SHALL ensure that a roadmap item depending on a contract becomes a ready queue entry when its dependency reaches contract_complete, before that dependency is implemented.

#### Scenario: A roadmap item depending on a contract becomes a ready queue entry when its...

WHEN `contract-dependencies` is implemented
THEN A roadmap item depending on a contract becomes a ready queue entry when its dependency reaches contract_complete, before that dependency is implemented.

### Requirement: Existing bare depends_on entries keep implementation-complete semantics, and...

The system SHALL ensure that existing bare depends_on entries keep implementation-complete semantics, and all existing roadmaps validate unchanged against the extended schema.

#### Scenario: Existing bare depends_on entries keep implementation-complete semantics, and...

WHEN `contract-dependencies` is implemented
THEN Existing bare depends_on entries keep implementation-complete semantics, and all existing roadmaps validate unchanged against the extended schema.

### Requirement: /implement-feature provides a contract-generated stub for each contract...

The system SHALL ensure that /implement-feature provides a contract-generated stub for each contract dependency that is not yet implemented.

#### Scenario: /implement-feature provides a contract-generated stub for each contract...

WHEN `contract-dependencies` is implemented
THEN /implement-feature provides a contract-generated stub for each contract dependency that is not yet implemented.

### Requirement: contract_complete is recorded in roadmap.yaml / loop-state.json, so a...

The system SHALL ensure that contract_complete is recorded in roadmap.yaml / loop-state.json, so a rebuilt queue reproduces the same readiness.

#### Scenario: contract_complete is recorded in roadmap.yaml / loop-state.json, so a...

WHEN `contract-dependencies` is implemented
THEN contract_complete is recorded in roadmap.yaml / loop-state.json, so a rebuilt queue reproduces the same readiness.

### Requirement: The memory-store simulation scenario shows reduced...

The system SHALL ensure that the memory-store simulation scenario shows reduced time-blocked-on-dependency compared with its baseline.

#### Scenario: The memory-store simulation scenario shows reduced...

WHEN `contract-dependencies` is implemented
THEN The memory-store simulation scenario shows reduced time-blocked-on-dependency compared with its baseline.
